components.name: InfiniteCanvas
components.description: A pannable, zoomable surface that goes on forever in every direction. Drag the background (or hold space, or use the middle button) to pan, scroll to pan, pinch or ctrl + scroll to zoom at the pointer, and drag items to move them. Arrow keys pan the canvas, or move the focused item.

props.name: onItemsChange
props.description: Called with the updated list when an item is moved.

props.name: getItemLabel
props.description: Screen reader name for an item. Defaults to "item n".

props.name: defaultView
props.description: `"fit"` frames every item once they have been measured.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Id of the selected item, or null for none.

props.name: gap
props.description: Background spacing in world units. Also the snap step.

props.name: snap
props.description: Moved items land on the background grid.

props.name: wheel
props.description: What a plain mouse wheel does. Pinch and ctrl + wheel always zoom.

props.name: controls
props.description: Zoom buttons and a fit button in the bottom-left corner.

props.name: minimap
props.description: An overview in the bottom-right corner. Click or drag it to move.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Items can be selected but not moved.

props.name: children
props.description: World-space content drawn under the items, positioned by you.

examples.title: read only · grid, wheel zooms, fit on mount
examples.code:
<InfiniteCanvas
  aria-label="Flow chart"
  className="h-72"
  defaultItems={CHART}
  defaultView="fit"
  background="grid"
  wheel="zoom"
  readOnly
/>
